These request/template attributes can only be assigned after `handler.inference()` has already started the span, so head samplers cannot inspect them. Add them as keyword arguments to the inference factory and constructor, initialize them before `_start()`, and include them in `_get_start_attributes()`; they can still remain mutable for finish-time updates.

Accept `top_k` on `TelemetryHandler.retrieval()`/`RetrievalInvocation.__init__` and add it to `_get_start_attributes()` instead of relying solely on the finish-time assignment.
